title: Independent extraction from a GitHub-sourced Dell BIOS image (Latitude 5440, BIOS 1.28.1)
why_it_matters: 9ABE is the newest displayed suffix on GitHub (issue #333, 2026-10-13). This is a real 5440-family image from the same GitHub corpus; its own password module says how 9ABE is handled.

joined.note: cat part1 part2; PFS.HDR at file offset 0xe87d8

system_bios.name: 1 BIOS_IMG_candidate -- 1 System BIOS with BiosGuard v1.28.1.bin

extraction_chain: Dell PFS extract (chromebreakerdev/DellBIOSTools vendor/biosutilities/dell_pfs_extract.py, class DellPfsExtract) -> Firmware/System BIOS with BiosGuard v1.28.1.bin
uefi_firmware AutoParser (pip uefi_firmware) -> FFS GUID C7CAF1C7-... -> section1.pe (DellSecurityVaultSmm)
stdlib PE section walk: .text VA 0x1000 raw 0x400; .data VA 0x9000 raw 0x8000 (delta -0x1000)

ec_routed_family_list.note: 0xFFFF terminator. Matches CF1B_FINDINGS.md section 11 family list at 0x81F8-class. HddPwSmm carries the same list at file 0x5210 (preceded by 0001 FFFF).

local_keygen_descriptor_table.note: 24-byte entries {u16 suffix, u16 pad, u32 pad, u64 params@+8, u64 alphabet@+16}. 8FC8 params = NULL (no host-side derivation). E7A8 params VA 0x9178. 0xFFFF terminates. No 9ABE / CF1B / 3FE2 / 1B58 descriptor exists anywhere in this module.

e7a8_params.note: Byte-identical to bacher09/pwgen-for-bios src/keygen/dell/encode.ts:403-413 (TagE7A8Encoder) and to serversupdep-ai/Bin-file tools/dell_e7a8_pure.py. Confirms the last local algorithm is unchanged in this 5440-class image.

alphabets.note: Both are 72 chars and permutations of the same multiset. The 8FC8 table equals the alphabet recovered at 0x91A0 in pwgen-for-bios issue 80 comment 5067918343 and ALPHABET0 in Zte CF1B_FINDINGS.md section 11.3.

false_positive_warning.observed: a naive u16 context dump around 0x81f8 shows "6A49 5A6B 1B58 9ABE 3FE2 CF1B 8FC8 FFFF"
false_positive_warning.explanation: 0x6A49 and 0x5A6B are the ASCII bytes "I j" and "k Z" — the last four characters of the E7A8 alphabet ending ...JXGabIjkZ. They are NOT new suffix words. Dell_newbios_probe.py prints them only because it dumps 3 words of context before the first known word.
false_positive_warning.impact: do not treat 6A49/5A6B as new suffixes without a code cross-reference. Confidence: proven (byte-level inspection).

verdict.local_keygen_suffixes: E7A8 only (of the modern suffixes); legacy suffixes use the older MD5-family path
verdict.host_side_algorithm_for_9ABE: none: family is in the EC-routed list only; master = EC GENERATE response rendered (verbatim resp[0:16])

confidence: proven for extracted bytes/offsets (recomputable from the committed PE); probable for mapping this image to the displayed suffix 9ABE (same model family/BIOS line as issues #324/#333, but the image itself does not record the lock-screen suffix).
